logistic_regression.name: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.desc: Baseline linear classifier with log-odds link; offers interpretable feature coefficients.

knn_classifier.name: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
knn_classifier.desc: Instance-based non-parametric classifier using distance-weighted nearest neighbours.

gaussian_naive_bayes.name: Gaussian Naive Bayes
gaussian_naive_bayes.desc: Probabilistic classifier assuming class-conditional feature independence.

decision_tree.name: Decision Tree Classifier
decision_tree.desc: Orthogonal hyperplane recursive tree partitioner; captures nonlinear guest interactions.

svc.name: Support Vector Classifier (SVC)
svc.desc: Maximum margin hyperplane separator in kernelized space with Platt scaling probabilities.

random_forest.name: Random Forest Classifier
random_forest.desc: Bagged ensemble of randomized decision trees; reduces variance and achieves highest overall F1.

adaboost.name: AdaBoost Classifier
adaboost.desc: Adaptive boosting ensemble focusing iteratively on misclassified booking instances.

gradient_boosting.name: Gradient Boosting Classifier
gradient_boosting.desc: Stage-wise additive ensemble optimizing binary cross-entropy loss.

bagging.name: Bagging Classifier (Decision Trees)
bagging.desc: Bootstrap aggregation of deep decision trees with majority voting.

mlp_classifier.name: MLP Classifier (Neural Network)
mlp_classifier.desc: Multi-layer perceptron neural network with backpropagation and ReLU activations.
